description: Two sentences far apart: physiotherapy 'completed' vs 'unable to attend'. No lexical flag; needs claim reconciliation.

request.clinicalNote: Chronic low back pain with left L5 radicular features for four months. Straight-leg raise positive on the left. The patient completed a six-week course of physiotherapy earlier this year with a musculoskeletal physiotherapist. Oral analgesia trialled. Symptoms persist and are limiting work as a warehouse operative. Of note, transport and shift patterns meant the patient was ultimately unable to attend the physiotherapy sessions that were arranged, and the course was not undertaken. Requesting MRI to plan management.

criteria.text: at least six weeks of completed physiotherapy
